_comment: Issue #179, Hungarian prefixes on every PRIVATE declaration.
Not here, by decision: function block pins, method parameters, GVL members
and struct members. They are the published interface - every installation
names them at a call site, and a shared block reaches into GVL_MQTT by name -
so prefixing them is a downstream break for no runtime gain. MQTT topics are
string literals, so nothing here changes what Home Assistant sees.
Generated by scratchpad/gen_internals_map.py from an info -Full report.
A group per declaring object; loose mode where the name is unambiguous
project-wide (so the persistent list's instance paths follow), local where
two objects disagree about what the same name should become, plus a local
group per derived block because an inherited variable is read bare there.
